name: Jiefeng Sun
title: Assistant Professor
department: Aerospace and Mechanical Engineering, School for Engineering of Matter, Transport and Energy
fitReason: Concrete learned-dynamics control on physical soft robots, with current summer-intern inquiries welcomed. Stronger in data-efficient control and hardware integration than foundation models or end-to-end reinforcement learning.

physicalEvidence.summary: September 2, 2026 preprint reports learned Koopman/MPC shape control on actual three- and five-segment cable-driven arms, using Dynamixel actuators, OptiTrack and ROS 2. Ten-segment results are simulation only. References are predefined and external motion capture is required. Separate 2026 RA-L work demonstrates physics-informed Koopman control of an artificial-muscle continuum robot; ASU news identifies the corresponding student-led hardware in Sun's current Tempe lab.

shortVisit.summary: Current lab Openings page explicitly welcomes visiting scholars and summer research interns to email Sun about available opportunities. The same page says no expected Fall 2027 PhD opening, under its separate PhD heading. Local ASU master's thesis recruitment and dated December 2025 SURI advertising do not establish an external summer 2027 funded place.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct learning-based robot control, though narrower control/materials emphasis than general embodied AI or RL.
scoreReasons.physical: Current student-led hardware connected to the ASU lab, actual multi-segment control experiments and separate artificial-muscle learning controller.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Explicit current summer-intern inquiry invitation; no specified eight-week duration or confirmed external-master's place.
scoreReasons.freshness: September 2026 primary manuscript plus 2026 RA-L article and dated current-lab news.
